title: rbac v2: audit logging + KMS region pinning for data residency
author: Alexandra Nguyen
description:
Context: Customers in regulated industries asked for stronger guarantees around data residency and better traceability of KMS usage. This PR implements RBAC v2 policy primitives (resource scoping + audit hooks), ties KMS key selection to tenant region settings (region pinning), and adds audit-log enrichment so KMS operations and region context are recorded consistently.

Motivation: 1) Provide a first-class primitive for data residency enforcement (region pin per-tenant) that surfaces in the policy engine and key-selection path. 2) Make audit logs actionable for compliance by including KMS key IDs, key region, and the policy decision that allowed the operation. 3) Keep backwards compatibility with RBAC v1 and provide a migration path.

What changed (high level): - RBAC v2 schema and evaluation code (policy engine) - KMS provider changes: key resolution now respects tenant.region and will fail fast with a clear audit entry if no regional key is available - Audit pipeline: new enrichment stage attaches kms.key_id and kms.region and policy.version to audit events - Console/API: new tenant setting `preferred_data_region` and policy preview UI - Migration: compatibility shim that translates common RBAC v1 role rules into v2 resource scopes where possible

Checklist: - [x] RBAC v2 schema + evaluator implemented and unit-tested - [x] KMS region pinning implemented with feature flag - [x] Audit enrichment implemented and end-to-end tested against local collector - [x] Console settings + policy preview wired and tested - [x] Migration guide and changelog updated - [x] Load tests run to validate latency impact (no regressions >2%)

Testing: unit tests (policy engine, kms resolver), integration tests (audit pipeline), e2e test against local KMS emulator, internal load test harness (perf-canary) with synthetic tenants. CI summary below.

Rollout plan: 1) Feature-flagged rollout in staging for internal customers; 2) Gradual enable by customer region with monitoring on audit volume and KMS error rates; 3) 7-day canary for API surface customers; 4) Post-rollout audit verification runbook.

Related: Linear ENG-2041, SEC-512; Jira SUP-231.

review_comments: Taylor Rivera (2026-02-12): Left a few nits on the evaluator semantics - can we make resource scope matching deterministic across map iteration? Also please add a perf test for worst-case policy lists.
Alexandra Nguyen (2026-02-13): Reply: addressed deterministic matching by sorting scopes before evaluation and added a micro-benchmark in perf-canary. PTAL.
Maya Chen (2026-02-16): Question: what happens if tenant has preferred region but no key exists there? We should fail open/closed decision documented.
Alexandra Nguyen (2026-02-17): Reply: we fail-fast with a 409 + audit entry indicating missing key; fallback to global key is gated behind an explicit tenant opt-in. Added tests & docs.
Ravi Kapoor (2026-02-22): Security scan flagged use of crypto library X in resolver - prefer internal wrapper; also approve pending unit test coverage for kms_enricher.
Alexandra Nguyen (2026-02-24): Reply: migrated resolver to use pkg/crypto/wrapper and added missing unit tests. Thanks Ravi.
